description: Get current EV/Revenue, EV/EBIT, EV/EBITDA, trailing and forward P/E, Price/Sales and Price/Book with peer median, quartiles and sample size; REITs add verified company-stated P/FFO and P/AFFO, and a verified reconciliation adds EV over the stated Adjusted EBITDA. TTM flows use four discrete fiscal quarters or an exact annual-plus-YTD bridge; annual-only figures are not TTM. P/E uses validated diluted EPS or income available to common, with the basis named. EV/EBITDA adds TTM depreciation and amortization to TTM operating income. Forward P/E uses the analyst consensus EPS, possibly adjusted, for the first fiscal year ending after today, with that year and the analyst count. EV uses same-date reported debt, cash and short-term investments. Inputs must reconcile, share one split basis and be in USD; none is estimated. Peers exclude the company: similar-size industry peers when sufficient, else the full industry. Every figure is dated. Use GetValuationMultiplesHistory for history.

title: Valuation Multiples
